title: Australia (starter profile)
note: Starter profile. Emergency numbers and emergency warning signs (transcribed from healthdirect Australia) are filled in. To be discussed and maintained by a community in this region.

emergency.message: In a life-threatening emergency, call Triple Zero (000) now. If you are not sure whether to seek care, you can call the healthdirect helpline on 1800 022 222.

redFlags: Loss of consciousness (blackout or fainting) — even if brief
Sudden weakness in the face, arm or leg or trouble speaking — these could be signs of a stroke
A sudden collapse or unexplained fall
Any other major concern about a person's health or wellbeing
Stings or bites from snakes, jellyfish or other poisonous animals
An injury from a major car accident
Been physically assaulted, including stabbing or shooting
